inputs.name: hand over from Data Versioning to Feature Store

output.level_0: Data versioning outputs corrupt, making the feature store reject every nightly batch.
output.level_1: No link exists, so feature store builds stale views from raw till scans.
output.level_2: Analysts manually copy versioned data into the feature store before each retrain.
output.level_3: A pipeline automatically syncs versioned data into the feature store every night.
output.level_4: Governed sync ensures only approved, consent compliant data reaches the feature store.
